text:
Kara (Product): Quick note: rolling Private Data Access Policy v1 to on-prem/VPC agents at 20:00 UTC. This adds per-tenant access controls for operator actions (diagnostics, live-debug) + an auditable access trace. Customers can opt to require dual-approval for any operator-initiated session.

Ike (Eng): Implementation: agent checks local policy.json for operator_allowlist and require_dual_approval flag. Operator session flow emits an access_trace bundle with fields: trace_id, operator_id, actions[], timestamp, signed_by_agent_kid. Example: ```POST /agent/operator/session -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"tenant":"acme","operator":"ops@acme"}'``` Reply: trace_id + session_url.

Marta (SRE): Rollout plan: quick canary (5 customers) 20:00-20:10, watch access-trace-generation-fail and operator-session-fail. Rollback if trace generation fails >0.3% in 5m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary start for private-access-policy-v1 at 2026-07-15T20:00Z.

Kara (Product): Action items: Legal - wording for "auditable access trace" and dual-approval; Support - KB steps for verifying traces; Sales - short customer note + CSM list.

Ben (Legal): Review underway. Need trace to include signer_kid and canonicalized action list to be audit-friendly. Dual-approval wording: specify who can approve and retention requirements.

Sam (Sales): Can we get a 20-word TL;DR? Also need the canary list for proactive outreach.

Ike (Eng): Draft TL;DR: "New on-prem access controls: require approval for operator sessions and produce signed access traces for audits." Will push full FAQ to #docs after GA.

Marta (SRE): Canary metrics @20:07: 5 operator sessions attempted, 5 traces created, median trace emit 45ms, no failures. Proceeding to full rollout at 20:12.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Full rollout initiated for private-access-policy-v1 at 2026-07-15T20:12Z.

Ben (Legal): OK to GA once Support KB link present. Proposed audit sentence: "The agent emits a signed access trace (trace_id, operator_id, actions, signer_kid, timestamp) to evidence operator activity."

Jun (Support): Adding KB: "Verify operator access traces" with steps: call /agent/operator/traces/<id>, validate signer_kid, check actions[], collect logs if mismatch. Will post link here.

Kara (Product): Thanks team. Sales, hold public announcement until Support and Legal sign off. If anomalies, tag #eng-oncall and @Kara. Will post final GA copy here.
